rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a very poor-quality blastocyst/1DD, noting absent-poor ICM and TE and no hatching, but it is somewhat hedged and includes uncertainty about collapse/day-4 labeling rather than a precise image-based morphology description.

Integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, prior IVF history, prior live birth, endometrial thickness, partner age, and semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis; only minor overreach such as implying repeated 9 MII eggs across cycles.

Reasoning is mostly logical and the low implantation estimate follows from poor morphology plus age and prior failures. Minor inconsistencies remain around day-4 blastocyst interpretation and speculative comments about transfer timing/progesterone.

Largely aligned with IVF practice: poor-prognosis counseling, single embryo transfer, uterine cavity review after repeated failure, cautious individualized discussion of PGT-A. Small deviations include speculative adjunctive comments and some nonstandard emphasis on alcohol cessation.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including SET, luteal support, uterine evaluation, sperm DNA fragmentation consideration, and PGT-A discussion. Useful but not highly specific to protocol-level decision making.
